tasks.spec: ROLE: fix worker for the Mott booking gateway, lane 47 (never override a more specific explicit date with a less specific sentence reading). Work entirely inside your CWD; never modify anything outside it; no network, no git, no MCP/Apps/skills, no deploys. CONTEXT - decisive live probe just now: with user_text='No Thursday the 27', the request from='08/27/2026' returned 08/06 slots. The authoritative user_text layer read the bare weekday 'Thursday' out of the sentence, resolved it to the next Thursday (08/06), and overrode the fully-specified explicit from. Same probe with user_text='08/27/2026' correctly returns 08/27, proving the override is the cause. This is how a patient can be shown one date while a different one is searched and ultimately booked - the highest-severity class we have. THE RULE (general, replaces case-by-case patching): compute a SPECIFICITY rank for both the explicit from/to fields and the layer's own sentence-derived date. Ranks: 3 = full calendar date (MM/DD/YYYY, YYYY-MM-DD, month-name plus day, or weekday qualified by a week reference); 2 = day-of-month ordinal ('the 27', 'the 27th') or relative offset ('in 2 weeks', '2 weeks from today'); 1 = bare weekday or bare 'today'/'tomorrow'; 0 = nothing found. The sentence reading may override the explicit from ONLY when its rank is STRICTLY GREATER than the explicit from's rank. Equal or lower rank must defer to the explicit from. Keep the lane-40 availability-semantics override and the lane-46 anaphora deference working: the away-sentence case ('leaving town today, back in 2 weeks' with from='in 2 weeks') must still resolve to today+14 - note its sentence rank (2, a relative offset) versus the explicit from's rank (2) means you must ALSO keep the existing departure/availability special case as an explicit exception that wins regardless of rank; document that exception clearly. Additionally: teach the sentence reader to parse day-of-month ordinals ('the 27', 'the 27th', 'Thursday the 27') as rank 2, resolving to that day-of-month in the nearest future month (this month if the day has not passed, else next month). BASE FILE: ./deployed-bland_gateway.py is byte-equal to production image mott-lane-46. Minimal in-style diff. TESTS (frozen-today pattern, handler-level seam as lane 44b/46 used): (a) from='08/27/2026', user_text='No Thursday the 27' -> 08/27 (explicit wins); (b) from='thursday the 27', user_text='No Thursday the 27' -> 08/27 (ordinal parsed, rank 2 beats bare weekday); (c) from='in 2 weeks', away-sentence user_text -> today+14 (exception preserved); (d) from='monday the week of 08/18/2026', user_text='What about Monday that week?' -> 08/17 (anaphora deference preserved); (e) from='thursday', user_text='thursday please' -> next Thursday (unchanged); (f) full existing suite green in ./gwtest (copy of /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGW46/gw-anaphora-defer-fix/gwtest with fixed file installed, plus the cumulative tree at /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGW44b/gw-week-vocab-live-fix/gwtest if the anaphora tree is partial - run BOTH and report both). ./proof_specificity.py: standalone offline, handler-level, prints 'CASE=explicit-beats-weekday FROM=2026-08-27', 'CASE=ordinal FROM=2026-08-27', 'CASE=away-exception DATE=<real today+14 iso>', 'CASE=anaphora FROM=2026-08-17'. DEBUG-GW47.md: the probe evidence, the specificity table, the away exception, output tails, deploy separately gated.
tasks.check: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 ./proof_specificity.py > proof.out 2>&1 || { echo 'FAIL: proof crashed'; tail -5 proof.out; exit 1; }; exp=$(python3 -c "import datetime;print((datetime.date.today()+datetime.timedelta(days=14)).isoformat())"); for c in 'CASE=explicit-beats-weekday FROM=2026-08-27' 'CASE=ordinal FROM=2026-08-27' "CASE=away-exception DATE=$exp" 'CASE=anaphora FROM=2026-08-17'; do grep -q "$c" proof.out || { echo "FAIL: missing $c"; cat proof.out; exit 1; }; done; cd gwtest && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest -q > ../pytest.out 2>&1; rc=$?; cd ..; summary=$(tail -1 pytest.out); [ $rc -eq 0 ] || { echo "FAIL: suite red: $summary"; tail -10 pytest.out; exit 1; }; echo "$summary" | grep -qE '^[0-9]+ passed' || { echo "FAIL: summary not clean: $summary"; exit 1; }; grep -qi 'specificity' DEBUG-GW47.md || { echo 'FAIL: DEBUG lacks the specificity table'; exit 1; }; echo "PASS: specificity rule proven - $summary"
tasks.verified: The gateway never lets a vaguer sentence reading override a more specific explicit date, ordinals resolve properly, and both prior overrides (away-sentence semantics, anaphora deference) still hold - proven at the handler seam plus the full suite.
